senses.gloss: to overpower, rob. Tanḥ. T’rumah 9 (ref. to Mal. III, 8) לשון ערבי … מה אתה קוֹבְעֵנִי it is an Arabic expression; when an Arab argues with his neighbor and wants to say, why wilt thou rob me?, he says, why art thou ḳob’ʿeni?; Yalk. Mal. 587 (read גוזלני for גמלני).

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yadayim 4:3">Yad. IV, 3</cite> <he>קוֹבֵעַ אתה … מלהוריד וכ׳</he> (by allowing the priests’ share to be given to the poor) thou preventest the heaven from sending down dew and rain.
